_comment: Weather and the time of day on the world map. Weather comes in cells that drift across the map: each of `count` slots picks a new cell every window_hours (staggered), with a kind (weights), a centre between `area` and a radius between `radius`, drifting up to `drift` map units over its window. Clear cells are just clear sky. An army marching out through a cell (its route passes within the radius when it sets off) takes `slow` longer for the whole march: the worst cell counts. The weather is worked out from the time alone, so the game and the server agree. day_hours is how long a whole day and night take on the map (the light only).
